fact: A news article of June 2026 reports the Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education's Primary and Secondary Education Statistics Report for 2025 (enrolment of 4,671,149 learners in 2025, dropouts by cause); the article does not name the school returns the report draws on, and the source is the ministry's school-based education data.
title: Zimbabwe's Literacy Success Masks a Growing Crisis of School Dropouts
